as 引导的倒装与比较结构: as/though 让步从句的倒装,以及 the more... the more、no more... than 等比较句式。
as/though 让步:形容词/副词/名词提前 + as/though + 主谓|Try as I might...;Cold as it was...|the + 比较级..., the + 比较级...|no more... than = 和……一样不|比较的对象要对应:than mine / than I did
Tired as she was, she kept the shop open.
column3: 她虽然很累,还是让店开着门。

as 引导的倒装与比较结构: Try as he might, the engine wouldn't start.
column3: 他怎么折腾,发动机就是不着火。

as 引导的倒装与比较结构: The higher we climbed, the thinner the air became.
column3: 我们爬得越高,空气越稀薄。

as 引导的倒装与比较结构: Child as he was, he asked razor-sharp questions.
column3: 他虽是个孩子,问题却尖刻犀利。

as 引导的倒装与比较结构: The new printer is no more reliable than the old one.
column3: 新打印机和旧的一样不可靠。

# title: Try ___ she might, the jar refused to open.
column4: Try as sb might 是让步倒装的固定搭配。

# title: The more data we collect, ___ the pattern becomes.
column4: the + 比较级,the + 比较级:clearer。

# title: ___ as he was, the apprentice spotted the flaw at once.
column4: 单数名词提前时省冠词:Child as he was。

as 引导的倒装与比较结构: than mine|than yours|as yours|than you take the bus
column4: 比较对象要对应:than yours(your commute)。

# title: Which sentence uses concessive inversion correctly?
as 引导的倒装与比较结构: Much as I admire her, I disagree.|As much I admire her, I disagree.|Much I admire as her, I disagree.|I admire as much her, much I disagree.
column4: 副词 Much 提前 + as + 主谓,是让步倒装的正确形式。
